## Type

The blog does not have one typeface, and that is deliberate: **each mode carries its own typographic personality.** The base supplies the fallback everything else inherits.

- **Display:** MedievalSharp
- **Body:** Spectral
- **Wordmark:** Uncial Antiqua — set as "dylan's blog"

All sprite and header art must render with image-rendering: pixelated. Smoothing a pixel sprite is the one unforgivable sin.

## The book review card

Book reviews come in two depths — a **shelf talker** (250–400 words) and a **full review** (800–1200) — and both carry the same card.

### Enjoyment bar

A **hatched** bar, not a count of icons: it fills whatever width it is given, so one treatment serves the square card, the story frame and the in-post embed.

- Fill `#8060c0` on well `#0d0a12`, trough `#3a2a5c`
- 45° stripes on a 17px tile
- Animated: `barber` 2.6s linear. Blog embed only. The Instagram PNG freezes a frame.

**Never print a percentage on the enjoyment bar.** The bar never shows a number, anywhere. On a book card a percentage reads as reading progress — Kindle, StoryGraph and Goodreads all use it that way. A number also reintroduces the "is it 70 or 75" dithering the bar exists to avoid.

Label states:

- **complete** → `COMPLETE`
- **default** → nothing

### Shelf tags

Breadth, not quality. Orthogonal to the enjoyment bar, so the two can never contradict each other.

- `HAND-SELL` — I will put this in your hands
- `RIGHT-READER` — Niche, but if it is you, it is YOU
- `NOT-FOR-ME` — An honest miss, said kindly
